reason: I already lost two good stylists last year, and making the rest check in with a selfie and track every bill will make them feel I'm watching them like a thief. I paid for salon software once and my staff never touched it, so I'm not paying ₹5,000 to set up the same thing again.
objection: My staff will see the selfie and cash checks as me not trusting them, and either they won't use it or they'll walk to the salon next door.
would_change_my_mind: If I could switch off the selfie and staff tracking and just use the WhatsApp reminders and billing myself, with no setup fee, so I only pay if my customers actually come back more.
